2. PHONE TEST RISK, RANKED, WITH THE REDESIGN PATH NAMED IN ADVANCE. Weakest cold name is 'an open padlock'; the two features that carry it are the shackle clearly not passing through the body and the keyhole in the face, and the key is the first thing to sacrifice. (B) drop the key and open the shackle wider; (C) after TWO failed cold reads change the metaphor per the run-15 rule (a box with its lid raised against two boxes sealed with a taped cross).
